adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the backfill loop builds raw SQL via string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. The `h` value comes from `site_settings.value` (embeddable_hosts) and is not quoted/escaped via the DB adapter. If any stored host contains a single quote (or other SQL-significant characters), this can produce invalid SQL and fail the migration; it also creates an injection surface because arbitrary content from the setting is inserted into SQL verbatim.
